reason: Counts Playwright's own execution contexts through its internal delegate (`toImpl(page)` and `delegate._mainFrameSession` or `_contextIdToContext`). Strider keeps no execution-context registry a test can count, and its isolated worlds aren't a public surface.

Reads a frame's main-world global (`window['__foo']`) and passes a handle made in the page into that frame's evaluation, which rejects it. Strider's frame evaluation runs in the isolated world only, and a handle crosses only into its own realm.

Takes a frame's element handle (`frame.$('body')`) and passes it into the page's evaluation, which adopts it across frames (FR-007), or refuses it when the frames don't script each other (FR-008). Strider's frame locators re-resolve on use rather than retaining element handles, so there's no frame handle to pass.
